description: Critical approved behaviours linked to executable tests. manualQA:true means automation cannot honestly claim full coverage. Source contracts are NOT screenshot visual tests.

behaviours.description: Explicit Sign In required (autofill alone must not authenticate)
Browser-compatible credential autofill semantics (form attrs + submit); Save/offer is manual
behaviours.manualQANote: Chrome/Edge Save password and later autofill offer cannot be reliably automated without controlling the browser vault. Automated tests protect form semantics only.

behaviours.description: No plaintext password persistence in Zlog app storage
Sign out works and terminates authenticated application session
behaviours.manualQANote: Full Login→Dashboard→Sign out→Login with a real Supabase session is MANUAL QA / future authenticated E2E. Unit + wiring tests cover orchestration without credentials.

behaviours.description: Authenticated sessions persist across refresh and reopen via the Supabase cookie mechanism, mounted by the root proxy; protected routes redirect to login without a session
behaviours.manualQANote: Signed-in survival across a real browser close/reopen needs a live Supabase session and cannot run without credentials. Automated coverage proves the proxy is mounted, cookies refresh on every route, persistence is not disabled, and unauthenticated protected routes redirect.

behaviours.description: Two-choice Site Diary entry (Start New / Use Previous equal status)
Setup hierarchy: Reporting Company → Reporting on behalf of → Author → Project Details
Author is never derived from email / local-part / username
New diary does not enter existing-diary edit mode
Previous diary source immutable; result is a new record
behaviours.manualQANote: Browser journey with real saved diaries requires authenticated E2E. Helpers + source contracts protect immutability rules.

behaviours.description: No developer/storage language in user-visible Site Diary setup copy
No Report Branding / hex colour panel on Site Diary workbench
Signature at end of Site Diary workbench (not near beginning)
No redundant Project recap on workbench
No duplicate Author / Reporting On Behalf fields in workbench
Setup scrolls vertically
behaviours.manualQANote: Static overflowY contract is automated; live scroll feel on device remains manual Visual/Mobile QA.

behaviours.description: No horizontal overflow (viewport fit)
behaviours.manualQANote: Static no-100vw / overflow contracts automated; device horizontal scroll remains Release Gate Visual QA.

behaviours.description: Saved diary opens in neutral VIEW mode; Edit is explicit
behaviours.manualQANote: Authenticated browser open→view→edit journey is future E2E; mode helpers + UI chrome contracts are automated.

behaviours.description: New Diary vs Edit Existing Diary are distinct journeys; existing opens with its own saved data
behaviours.manualQANote: Full authenticated reopen journey remains manual / future E2E.

behaviours.description: Editing unrelated fields must not wipe saved sticky fields (anti-wipe)
Reporting Company name + logo persist as one identity
behaviours.manualQANote: Paired name/logo across real saves is manualQA; unit/journey helpers cover sticky defaults.

behaviours.description: Cover photo persistence — autosave + final save write cover_photo_url; Cover capture/edit UI lives on Project & Report Details (setup) only — Today’s Site Diary must not duplicate it; omit wipe unless explicit remove; Use as Basis carries cover forward; successful cover persistence clears stale cover-upload error banners
behaviours.manualQANote: Select cover → wait for Work saved → refresh/reopen + Saved Diaries + PDF must show the same cover; replacement must not leave a false red upload error.

behaviours.description: Project Reference sticky on projects column; survives unrelated edits
Author name/role sticky from the signed-in profile; selected existing project hydrates its saved Project Manager
Report Date: new = browser-local today (editable); existing = saved date; no leak into new diary

Today's diary opens through populated Project & Report Details — including Use as Basis for New Diary from an opened saved diary — and Continue opens the same report in compose without duplicating or resetting report content
behaviours.manualQANote: Authenticated setup-first navigation, populated values, and same-report content preservation require live manual QA; route, CTA, update-vs-create, and report-ID contracts are automated.

behaviours.description: Reporting On Behalf Of prefills from the signed-in user's most recently used value on a genuinely new diary and remains editable
behaviours.manualQANote: Live latest-value selection and editable setup behavior require authenticated manual QA; helper and wiring regressions are automated.

behaviours.description: New diary preselects the user's last-used existing project; Address and Manager remain project-specific; new-project Working Days defaults to 5
behaviours.manualQANote: Authenticated last-used-project selection and editable project switching require manual QA; helper and persistence-plan regressions are automated.

behaviours.description: Project Start Date and Planned Completion Date are project-level and hydrate together; a new project starts with both blank; a blank setup date field never erases the saved project date
behaviours.manualQANote: Live hydrate-on-reopen for both dates requires authenticated manual QA; persistence-plan and hydrate helpers are automated.

behaviours.description: Blank diary fields cannot erase project-owned Name, Address, Manager, Working Days, programme dates, or Reference; Current Phase is stored per diary and never inherited from the project
behaviours.manualQANote: Authenticated save/reopen and the applied daily_reports.current_phase migration require live manual QA; ownership and payload rules are automated.

behaviours.description: View Saved Diaries is one of exactly two equal Site Diary hub cards and performs same-report retrieval; saved Site Diary photo areas show their photos and captions by default without leaking content into a new diary
behaviours.manualQANote: Authenticated saved-report selection and mobile visual review of 1 / 4 / 6 photo densities require manual QA; same-report routing, visible review wiring, caption association, Edit identity, and new-diary isolation are automated.

behaviours.description: Opening a saved diary from View Saved Diaries renders one continuous read-only document (Project & Report Details with Cover near the beginning, Current Phase, all saved sections, photo evidence with captions, signature); Edit This Diary opens full workbench editability only — never setup/details-only; no compose controls and no write on open
behaviours.manualQANote: Authenticated open of a real saved diary and mobile visual review of the continuous document require manual QA; document order, Current Phase source, read-only surface, photo/caption visibility and no-write behaviour are automated.

behaviours.description: Temporary Works & Scaffolding Checks sits after Equipment on hire and before Visitors; supports Temporary works apply today / Not applicable today; structured multi-item records with scaffold-only check/inspection status options; persists on the diary and maps into saved review / PDF
behaviours.manualQANote: Authenticated save/reopen of Temporary Works records and mobile visual review of the section require manual QA; section position, applicability labels, scaffold options, payload/hydrate and PDF handoff are automated.

behaviours.description: Saved Site Diaries can be deleted for real via confirmed Delete Diary on the opened diary (and project recent list); children cascade; Storage cleanup is durable and skips assets still referenced elsewhere; remaining diaries, the project, and shared branding stay
behaviours.manualQANote: Authenticated delete of a real saved diary, Storage orphan/reference-safety on live data, and mobile visual review of opened-diary Delete Diary / confirmation remain manual QA; copy, confirmation, RPC wiring, cascade/outbox source contracts and remaining-list behaviour are automated.

behaviours.description: View Saved Diaries is a compact mobile-first browsing list: project/date/shift identity, entire row opens review, no Open/Use for Today/Delete row controls, and one sticky contextual bar with Back plus Tap a diary to open and review it.
behaviours.manualQANote: Source contracts protect row/action/state wiring, tap-target declarations and overflow guards. Authenticated phone inspection must confirm practical 5–7 record density, outdoor legibility, wrapping, sticky Back, and no viewport obstruction.

behaviours.description: The Saved Site Diary review keeps Back accessible throughout the continuous record in a compact sticky action area while the Zlog header, navigation title, report title and report content scroll normally
behaviours.manualQANote: Source contracts protect the viewer opt-in, single Back control, opaque top:0 dock and default-off shared-shell behaviour. Authenticated phone QA on 2026-08-17 confirmed Back remains accessible, the report scrolls normally beneath it, the treatment is compact, and the header/title/report layout remain unfrozen and correct.

behaviours.description: In-progress Site Diary workbench content autosaves onto the existing daily_reports row after a short pause so an interrupted session can be resumed; Save / Share still finalises with Saving… then Saved ✓ only after persistence succeeds, then opens Share/complete — never Saved✓ or Share on failed save; persist UI is mutually exclusive (idle|saving|saved|error) so a failed save never also shows Work saved
behaviours.manualQANote: Authenticated phone QA must confirm Weather / H&S survive a killed tab on the same report id, status copy stays honest when offline, Saving… → Saved ✓ appears before Share, and Save / Share still completes. Start a New Diary must still create a new diary.

behaviours.description: Site Diary workbench Save Area / Save / Share / Share Report use PrimaryCTA surface=workbench (restrained rust-framed plate), not landing powder-coat; dashboard/auth keep the default brand PrimaryCTA
behaviours.manualQANote: Source contracts lock the shared surface=workbench variant. Authenticated phone QA must confirm no glossy orange-gradient workbench CTAs remain on the diary editor or saved-diary review.

behaviours.description: Approved UI terminology remains present (Site Diary, Sign out, Project & Report Details, Continue to Today's Diary, …)
behaviours.manualQANote: Source-string contract only — not visual layout protection.

behaviours.description: Declared task scope blocks unrelated protected/high-risk file edits
Approved locked screens have screenshot baselines; known_regression screens (dashboard Sign out) are not baselined
behaviours.manualQANote: Playwright compares committed PNGs for landing/login. Dashboard/Sign out/diary shells require manual confirmation before status flips to approved and baselines are created via test:visual:update.

behaviours.description: Checkpoint ab65437 — coloured PdfHeader banner repeats on every physical PDF page via in-flow PageChrome; orientation work must not regress this stack
behaviours.manualQANote: Real Android phone must confirm the coloured banner is visible on every printed page. Source contracts lock PageChrome-per-Page wiring and forbid orientation imports in PdfHeader/diary-pdf-layout.

behaviours.description: Checkpoint ab65437 — page-1 PDF appearance preserved; content clears the repeated header; PdfFooter behaviour intact
behaviours.manualQANote: Phone QA must confirm page-1 chrome matches the approved appearance and body content does not overlap the header. Automated tests cover layout constants and footer wiring only.

behaviours.description: Checkpoint ab65437 — workbench Share persists then prepares/shares PDF on first tap; saved view falls through to download without a second tap; Report Complete PDF helpers remain wired
behaviours.manualQANote: Real Android phone must confirm Share prepares and delivers PDF in one gesture and Save/Share saving semantics remain honest. Source contracts lock prepare/share/download wiring — not share-sheet UX.
